exact_computation: backward dynamic programme over the grid with per-month remaining-count states; saturating counter of T; factorial-moment pass for mean and variance; exact sampler by forward sampling from the same tables
null_model: Q_nu: alert set uniform over all sets on the notebook-32 placement grid with the observed counts per (calendar month, RV decile) cell and spacing >= 240 minutes

pvalues.exact: P_Q(T >= T_obs), no Monte Carlo error
pvalues.old: notebook-32 draw_budget, (1 + #) / (B + 1) with B = 200 (Q row) or the stored notebook-32 value (R row, B = 400)
pvalues.valid_mc: (1 + #(T* >= T_obs)) / (B + 1), B = 200 draws from the exact law (binomial representation)

variants: draw_budget without the >= 240-minute exclusion around the original alert

r_row.order: interleaved: shift r, block r for r < 200, then shift 200-399
r_row.surrogates: notebook-32 families regenerated with its seeds (400 circular shifts, 200 block derangements); guard: alerts and pre-onset catches equal the notebook-32 table

readings.implementation: randomized exact p in the Q row: rejection rate 99% interval must contain alpha at 0.01, 0.05, 0.10; otherwise stop interpreting
readings.old_vs_exact: paired difference of rejection decisions with 95% interval and one-sided discordance counts; McNemar exact p
readings.old_vs_nominal: Clopper-Pearson 95% interval of the rejection rate: covers alpha -> no evidence of size distortion; below -> conservative; above -> anti-conservative
readings.r_row: surrogates are not independent; intervals are descriptive; surrogate no-skill is not the same hypothesis as Q_nu
readings.reporting: the same tables are reported whatever the size or direction of the differences
readings.separation: exclusion = old - no-exclusion; sequential and nearest-decile = no-exclusion - valid MC from the exact law; MC resolution = valid MC - exact (Q row only)

statistic: pre-onset catches T (notebook-32 fast_counts pre); equals the number of alerts on pre-onset minutes because the 210-minute judging windows are shorter than the cooldown and disjoint (checked)
status: exploratory; appendix; no confirmatory plan changed
title: Exact conditional null for the budget-preserving regime-matched alert null (exploratory; appendix)
